evidence.title: EGAMA-RC: Risk-Calibrated Evidence-Gated Adaptive Malware Analysis for Robust and Interpretable Memory-Forensic Triage

summary: Researchers introduce EGAMA-RC, an adaptive AI system improving malware triage by combining risk-calibrated analysis with interpretable memory forensics. The method aims to strengthen robustness and transparency in cybersecurity investigations.
title: New AI Framework EGAMA-RC Enhances Malware Analysis with Risk-Calibrated Memory Forensics
